item.title: Self-Hosted TACACS+ Server: tac_plus vs tacquito vs tac_plus-ng
item.description: Terminal Access Controller Access-Control System Plus (TACACS+) is the de facto standard for centralized authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA) of network infrastructure devices. While RADIUS remains common for user authentication, TACACS+ is preferred for managing routers, switches, firewalls, and other network equipment due to its granular command-level authorization and TCP-based reliability.
